transcript: New dream job unlocked. I was just at the invited dress for this year's Tony Awards, which was an absolute dream come true. They run through the entire ceremony from start to finish. Got to see the opening number, all of the performances. I obviously can't tell you anything about them, but I will say it's going to be an amazing ceremony. But for all of the awards, obviously they can't reveal who's gonna win. And so they assign a random winner for every category so that the whole production team can practice running through it. And they bring up a stand in to give the speech. And that's my new dream job. I wanna be the person that gives the fake speeches during the Tony Awards dress rehearsal. Like, how amazing would it be to be able to go up onto the Radio City stage and accept a Tony as celebrated actor Carrie Coon? And of course, most of the presenters are there, so you get to accept that award from people like Julia Louis Dreyfus or Billy Crystal or Darren Criss. I think the funniest was the guy accepting as Josh Henry, because, of course, Josh Henry is still gonna win, even in a fake award scenario. And he was just like, yeah, guys, I'm gonna be honest. I knew I was gonna win. We had another guy just shout out, go Knicks! The woman accepting as Christiani Pitts, got to talk about how hard it Is carrying a cake 8 shows a week. It's just so fun, both for the audience and for them. I'm sure they have other jobs, too. Like, I don't think this is the only thing they do for the ceremony, but, like, what a cool job to have.
classificationReason: Creator attended the Tony Awards invited dress rehearsal—a ceremony production run-through—not a specific stage production from the list. No show is reviewed; the content is about the Tonys event itself.
